{"reason": "Failure rows show two unhandled demand-forecast-error patterns: market-mismatch=#t (e.g., 254000, 216000) and forecast-bias=#t with bias-amount 0.065-0.081 below the 0.1 cutoff. Widening that branch to also fire on market-signal-mismatch and lowering the threshold to 0.05 recovers these unknowns without touching the supplier-delay branch.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
         (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
